name: Mental Baggage
source:
Mental Baggage is a short visual novel with five endings. The main topics of the game are friendship, sadness and, maybe, some love. Teenage life, you could say.

Try all the branches of this story to find out the background behind our stupid protagonist and Camie!

[From [url=https://tv2games.itch.io/mental-baggage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《精神包袱》是一部有五个结局的短篇视觉小说。游戏的主题是友谊、悲伤，也许还有一些爱情。青少年生活，你可以说。

尝试这个故事的所有分支，找出我们愚蠢的主角和卡米背后的背景！

[来自[url=https://tv2games.itch.io/mental-baggage]Itch.io[/url]]
